data.name: Woodland Warriors
data.detailed_description:
Woodland Warriors is a cooperative hack-and-slash adventure where two players step into the roles of cutesy woodland animals fighting to save their home. With the forest mutating under the toxic influence of the dragon Porsogello, you and your partner must slash, bash, and puzzle-solve your way through corrupted biomes to restore balance and protect the Woodland creatures.

HACK, SLASH, AND TEAM UP

At its core, Woodland Warriors is about thrilling combat in a vibrant, story-rich world. Wield light, heavy, and ranged attacks as you carve through waves of enemies, and chain together combos to unleash devastating power. With multiple playable characters (each with unique, upgradeable abilities), you can adapt your strategy to suit your playstyle.

PUZZLES & PARTNERSHIP

More than just combat, Woodland Warriors thrives on cooperation. Bounce pads, pressure plates, and levers scattered across the levels demand teamwork and timing. Whether you’re solving puzzles or covering each other in battle, success is only possible when you work together.

MUTATED FOREST, MUTATED FOES

Porsogello’s toxic influence has twisted the once-peaceful creatures of Woodland into hostile threats. From vicious melee beasts to cunning ranged attackers, you’ll face a growing roster of enemies as you fight to cleanse each biome and push deeper into the corrupted forest.

PROGRESSION & UPGRADES

Strengthen your characters with an upgrade system spanning melee, ranged, and utility skills. Enhance your power with elemental effects, unlock new combat moves, and boost your survivability with health and utility upgrades, allowing for flexible builds and evolving strategies.

A QUEST TO SAVE THE FOREST

Guided by a mysterious Fisherman, players embark on a journey through portals that lead to corrupted biomes. Each victory brings you closer to confronting Porsogello, the dragon responsible for the forest’s downfall, and uncovering the mystery of the fractured realm known as the Never-Break.

Key Features

  • Challenging hack-and-slash combat with light, heavy, ranged, and combo attacks.

  • Three playable woodland heroes, each with unique, upgradable skills.

  • Strictly two-player co-op, playable online or in local split-screen.

  • Puzzle-driven exploration, with objects and contraptions that require teamwork.

  • Expanding upgrade system offering elemental powers, new moves, and shared or solo enhancements.

  • Vibrant biomes filled with mutated creatures, combat arenas, and light platforming challenges.

  • An epic story of friendship, courage, and saving the Woodland Forest from corruption.

data.short_description: WOODLAND WARRIORS is a two-player co-op combat adventure game featuring cute forest critters and intense hack and slash. Go on a quest with three woodland friends to find and investigate the sources of the strange happenings. Slash the enemies, solve the mystery, and save Woodland Forest.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti, AMD Radeon R7 260X, or Intel UHD 620
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • Additional Notes: System Requirements are subject to change

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
